title: Yellow triangel - no data?
symptom: Using AndroidAPS 3.1.0.3 and Android 13 with FSL2, the main screen sometimes shows 'no data' for varying durations (e.g., 521 minutes, 412 minutes), while the bolus calculator shows the newest value from xDrip. A yellow triangle appears on the screen, and clicking it and doing re-calculation doesn't help. The issue occurs regardless of flight mode.
cause: The yellow triangle is considered normal for Libre 2 because readings from xDrip are not sent exactly every 5 minutes. The root cause of the missing data on the main screen is not identified in the thread.
evidence_quote: the yellow triangle is "normal" for libre 2, since the readings from xDrip are not sent exactly every 5 minutes.
